accepted.s:
Arrange the following political parties in chronological order of their formation:
A. Bharatiya Jana Sangh
B. Swatantra Party
C. Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
D. Republican Party of India
accepted.x: The DMK was formed in 1949, the Jana Sangh in 1951, the Swatantra Party in 1959 and the Republican Party of India in 1956–57. Therefore, strictly by the supplied periods, the sequence should be DMK, Jana Sangh, RPI, Swatantra; none of the listed options reflects that sequence exactly.
accepted.tq: Check the dates before accepting a sequence; reject an option set that does not contain the valid chronology.
